note: Rejudged 2026-09-30 (ike-eap judge). TestRFC7296InitiatorChecksEachNATDetectionPayload drives handleSAInitResponse over a real encoded IKE_SA_INIT response: a SOURCE_IP mismatch alone sets NATDetected+PeerBehindNAT and floats to 4500, a DESTINATION_IP mismatch alone sets NATDetected+BehindNAT and floats, so ignoring either payload goes red. TestRFC7296InitiatorCheckFindsNoNATOnMatchingPayloads (both present, both matching: no NAT, not floated) goes red if presence alone were taken as a NAT, i.e. if the payloads were not checked. Both carry observed-red records on fsm.go handleSAInitResponse. HEAD tags on transport TestNATDetectionPresent/Absent (DetectNAT in isolation) are supplementary and hold no record.
